apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.
apps.versionDescription:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.7 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.7-ios-unsigned

### New Features

- **library**: Filter tracks missing verified ReplayGain tags
- **library**: Pause and resume library scans
- **backend**: Hold library scans in place while paused
- **library**: Select search results with a long press
- **metadata**: Add a primary artist tag mode
- **metadata**: Write primary-artist tags in native writers
- **album**: Replace selection sharing with metadata re-enrichment
- **appearance**: Add glass clarity controls and directional highlights
- **lyrics**: Keep the screen awake while viewing lyrics

### Bug Fixes

- **download**: Stop crashing native finalization on Android regex
- **backup**: Restore download and metadata provider order
- **background**: Keep library scans and update downloads running with the screen off
- **mornye**: Preserve navbar blur during collapse animations
- **mornye**: Soften glass rims and increase transparency
- **mornye**: Respect glass clarity and accessibility limits
- **library**: Spread filters across the search field width
- **library**: Offer re-enrichment for downloaded selections
- **lyrics**: Lift timed words together
- **storage**: Retain document access for library metadata and covers
- **startup**: Keep shared backend alive across activity recreation
- **download**: Verify ReplayGain tags independently of metadata embedding
- **metadata**: Preserve the selected recording during download enrichment
- **library**: Preserve partial scans and ignore stale completion events
- **library**: Open track metadata from search results

### Performance

- **mornye**: Share chrome backdrops and scale blur to clarity
- **store**: Skip invisible backdrop blur on repo cards
- **library**: Trim scan ingestion writes
- **library**: Stat each walked entry once
- **library**: Overlap SAF listings and metadata reads
- **mornye**: Adapt glass and player effects to device capabilities
- **player**: Suspend covered pages and streamline transitions
- **download**: Avoid repeated progress decoding and queue regrouping
- **download**: Reuse connections across probes and retries
- **library**: Reduce scan allocations and keep SAF workers busy
- **library**: Reuse bounded artwork thumbnails during scans

### Refactoring

- **library**: Share the track selection bar and delete action
- **backend**: Retire unused native bridge entry points
- **download**: Simplify finalization and remove the retired worker
- **flutter**: Remove unreachable state and widget APIs
- **library**: Remove unused history lookups and replacement paths
- **ui**: Consolidate file feedback and shared display helpers

### Testing

- **library**: Keep notifier test counters private

### Chores

- Update AltStore source to v5.0.7 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
- Update AltStore source to v5.0.6 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
- **release**: Bump app version to 5.0.7

### Build

- **android**: Reduce compat media deprecation warning noise
- **android**: Sign release APKs with APK Signature Scheme v4




**Full Changelog**: [v5.0.6...v5.0.7](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v5.0.6...v5.0.7)

---

### Downloads

#### Android
- **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.7-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices)
- **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.7-arm32.apk` (older devices)
- `*.apk.idsig`: V4 signatures for `adb install --incremental` only; normal installs do not need them

#### iOS
- **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.7-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)

### Installation
**Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK
**iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA
